description: Every place where two aesthetic thresholds, repair targets or bounds disagreed — or one concept was defined twice — and how the registry resolves it. Each assertion is evaluated by scripts/lint-conflicts.mjs against the resolved decisions of EVERY valid design context; an entry cannot go stale silently and cannot be vacuous.

entries.concept: negative space (留白) — void_ratio bounds, repairs and operator clamps
positions: SKILL.md 0.5 stated as a hard floor (it is a scoring signal)
hard floor 0.60 for bright-tone landscape only
period bands TANG 0.15-0.40 / SONG 0.35-0.80 / MING 0.25-0.50 against DC's SONG 0.35-0.65 and golden cell 0.68
CA-RULE-01 repair 0.45 and ANTI-AI-02 repair 0.48 below the 0.60 floor
operator clamp [0.05, 0.70] without evidence against documented 0.70-0.80 Song/Huizhou voids
evaluator treating void >= 0.70 as unbalanced while the skill treats it as the highest tier
entries.resolution: One metric (void_ratio). Period bands are the union of the evidence; the 0.60 floor applies to bright landscape only; 0.50 is a scoring signal; repairs and operator bounds are band edges or clamp(authored, effective band); ANTI-AI-02 is merged into CA-RULE-01; numeric caps without evidence are deleted.

entries.concept: target depth layers of the layering operator
positions: plan emission: 4 layers in every period (CAS-OT, migrated from the plan emitter)
operator: TANG 4 / SONG 5 / MING 3 (CAS-OP, migrated from the design operators)
entries.resolution: The operator's per-period table is canonical; plan emission references it ($ref). The period-independent 4 is deleted.

entries.concept: roughness targets of the material-contrast operator vs the period roughness bands
positions: period roughness bands TANG 0.30-0.60, SONG 0.40-0.80, MING 0.40-0.70 (TANG low/high and SONG low lay outside)
entries.resolution: Each authored target is clamped into the context's effective roughness band (ADR-0001 rule 6 generalised).

entries.concept: axial-symmetry bounds of the cluster-partition operator
positions: period axial-symmetry bands TANG 0.7-1.0, SONG 0.3-0.7, MING 0.5-0.8
entries.resolution: The operator may not push symmetry outside the period band: its bounds are the band edges ($band). The fixed clamp is deleted.

positions: grammar rule CA-RULE-02-YUNRUN repairs softness below 0.5
mist-scatter operator treats softness below 0.5 as hard light
entries.resolution: One definition: the operator's hard-light limit references the grammar rule's threshold ($ref).
